王野也没有在门房多待，就直接去了吴志强的办公室。一进屋就看见吴志强正在睡觉。王野跟自己师父可不客气，进门就喊：“吴叔，干嘛呢？”

吴志强一个激灵就醒了，拿起桌上的抹布就扔向王野：“你个小兔崽子，就不能小点声呀！真把我吓死了，对你有什么好处。”

王野接住抹布，坐在吴志强桌子对面说：“吴叔，我找你有事儿。”

吴志强没好气的说：“你小子哪次找我没事儿？你说说你，上班这么久了，有好事儿你找过我吗？”

王野狡辩道：“师父，我能有什么好事儿呀？”

吴志强说：“你赵爷爷都跟我说了，他现在就在你家吃饭。看老爷子的面色就知道，最近他伙食肯定不错。你小子有好吃的也不知道孝敬孝敬师父。”

那王野哪干呀，就说：“吴叔，咱可是天地良心呀！赵爷爷可跟我说了，本来孝敬赵爷爷的事儿就是你的。现在我都代劳了，你不夸夸我就算了，还抱怨我。看样子吴叔是觉得我越俎代庖了，回去我就还是让赵爷爷自己开火吧！”

王野那一脸欠揍的表情，气的吴志强牙根儿都痒痒。可是真的没有办法，他一个光棍儿。自己做的饭自己都不想吃，更别说赵爷爷了。虽然他知道王野肯定不会让自己师父自己开火，但是他也怕呀！要是这小子真在师父那里给自己上点眼药，就那老头的脾气，真会拿着棍子满厂子的追着他打。

看着王野那洋洋得意的样子，吴志强也只能叹口气，老的惹不起，现在小的也惹不起，难呀！只能无奈的问：“说吧！什么事儿？”

王野就把昨晚的事儿又跟吴志强说一遍。

吴志强听完说：“你说的这个杨满仓我有印象，三个月之前出的意外。厂里不是定性因公殉职吗？这是有人欺上瞒下呀！”

王野气愤的说：“吴叔，这是不是咱们保卫科的管理范围？”

吴志强站起来说：“那肯定是呀，走，喊人出门干活了！”

王野立刻出门先去了自己办公室，正好所有人都在。吴志强在办公室前的空地上简单说了一下，然后六个人立刻开始行动了。

不到中午，所有人都在吴志强的集合了。经过汇总，整件事情立刻就水落石出了。车间主任知道杨满仓家里没人，在他出事儿的第二天就开始操作这件事儿。车间主任联合劳资科一起，把杨满仓的福利和补助全部截留了。杨满仓的工作名额给了车间主任，他安排了自己的侄子，已经在工厂上了三个月的班了。而其他的补助和赔偿，都被劳资科的一个股长截留了。

这一次的截留可不是小数，当时厂里给了半年的工资作为补偿，是342块，加上丧葬费得有400块，而且每个月都有杨满仓工资的百分之二十，也就是11块4。这些钱够判十年的了。再加上杨满仓是因公殉职，十有八九可以获得“革命烈士”的称号。呵呵，这俩人拉出去打靶都有可能。

别看吴志强平时懒懒散散的，真有事儿，当兵的劲头立马就来了。那真是雷厉风行，两队人立刻抓捕，而他自己直接去了厂长办公室。没一会儿，两人就被押进了保卫科，厂里的领导全都来了。上到厂长，下到各科室主任，都在门外等着。

就在吴志强从审讯室里出来后，立刻就给厂长做了汇报。这件事儿捂不住了，厂长立刻回了办公室开始打电话。没一会儿就来了两辆吉普车，所有人都知道这件事儿上面接手了，这两个人完了。

人员交接完后，王野就回了办公室。刚要坐下，吴志强就带着两个人进来了。其中一个王野还认识，劳资科钱主任，另一个王野没见过。

吴志强说：“小野，给你介绍一下，这个你认识，钱主任，另一个是后勤李主任。”

Wang Ye didn't stay at the concierge any longer and went directly to Wu Zhiqiang's office.As soon as he entered the house, he saw Wu Zhiqiang sleeping.Wang Ye was not polite to his master. When he entered the door, he shouted: "Uncle Wu, what are you doing?"

Wu Zhiqiang woke up with a start, picked up the rag on the table and threw it at Wang Ye: "You little bastard, can't you keep your voice down! You scared me to death, what good is it to you."

Wang Ye caught the rag, sat across from Wu Zhiqiang's table and said, "Uncle Wu, I have something to do with you."

Wu Zhiqiang said angrily: "When has your kid ever come to me for anything? Tell me, you have been at work for so long, have you ever come to me for anything good?"

Wang Ye argued: "Master, what good can I do?"

Wu Zhiqiang said: "Your Grandpa Zhao has told me that he is eating at your house now. You can tell from the old man's face that he must be eating well recently. You kid has delicious food and you don't know how to be filial to your master."

Then what did Wang Ye do? He said: "Uncle Wu, we are the conscience of heaven and earth! Grandpa Zhao told me that originally it was your responsibility to honor Grandpa Zhao. Now I have done it for you. If you don't praise me, just forget it and complain about me. It seems that Uncle Wu thinks that I have overstepped my responsibilities. I will let Grandpa Zhao fire on his own when I get back!"

Wang Ye's expression looked like he wanted to be beaten, which made Wu Zhiqiang's teeth itch with anger.But there is really no way, he is a bachelor.I don’t even want to eat the food I cook, let alone Grandpa Zhao.Although he knew that Wang Ye would definitely not let his master fire on his own, he was still afraid!If this kid really gave himself some eye drops from the master, the old man would really be chasing him around the factory with a stick because of his temper.

Looking at Wang Ye's smug look, Wu Zhiqiang could only sigh. He couldn't offend the old man, and he can't offend the young one now. It's difficult!I could only ask helplessly: "Tell me! What's the matter?"

Wang Ye told Wu Zhiqiang what happened last night again.

After hearing this, Wu Zhiqiang said: "I remember the Yang Mancang you are talking about. He had an accident three months ago. Didn't the factory determine that he died in the line of duty? Someone was deceiving the superiors and hiding it from the subordinates!"

Wang Ye said angrily: "Uncle Wu, is this the management scope of our security department?"

Wu Zhiqiang stood up and said, "That's for sure. Let's go and ask people to go out to work!"

Wang Ye immediately went out and went to his office first, where everyone happened to be there.Wu Zhiqiang said briefly in the open space in front of the office, and then the six people immediately started taking action.

Before noon, everyone gathered at Wu Zhiqiang's.After summarizing, the whole thing came to light immediately.The workshop director knew that Yang Mancang had no one at home, so he started to take action on the second day after his accident.The workshop director, together with the labor and management department, withheld all Yang Mancang's benefits and subsidies.Yang Mancang's job quota was given to the workshop director, who arranged for his nephew to work in the factory for three months.Other subsidies and compensation were withheld by a section chief of the Labor and Employment Department.

This time the withholding was not a small amount. At that time, the factory gave half a year's salary as compensation, which was 342 yuan, plus funeral expenses, it was 400 yuan, and every month he received 20% of Yang Mancang's salary, which was 11 yuan.This amount of money is enough for a ten-year sentence.In addition, Yang Mancang died in the line of duty, and there is a high probability that he will be awarded the title of "revolutionary martyr".Haha, it is possible for these two people to be dragged out for target practice.

Although Wu Zhiqiang is usually lazy, if something really happens, he will be motivated to serve as a soldier immediately.It was so resolute that the two teams arrested him immediately, and he went directly to the factory director's office.After a while, the two were escorted into the security department, and all the factory leaders came.From the factory director to the directors of various departments, everyone was waiting outside the door.

As soon as Wu Zhiqiang came out of the interrogation room, he immediately reported to the factory director.Unable to suppress the matter, the factory director immediately returned to the office and started making phone calls.After a while, two jeeps arrived, and everyone knew that the higher-ups had taken over the matter, and these two people were finished.

After the handover of personnel, Wang Ye returned to the office.Just as he was about to sit down, Wu Zhiqiang came in with two people.Wang Ye also knew one of them, Director Qian of the Labor and Management Department, but Wang Ye had never met the other one.

Wu Zhiqiang said: "Xiao Ye, let me introduce to you. You know this one, Director Qian, and the other one is Logistics Director Li."
